findings.summary: 'вопрос, которого этот чат ждёт' says the chat is waiting FOR the question; the chat is waiting for the reader's ANSWER to it. 'ждать' takes the thing awaited in the genitive, so the relative clause names the wrong object. 'на который этот чат ждёт ответа' is the correct construction. Fits maxCells 70.
